programmes.d: An introverted architect helps an independent teenage girl to build a raft that can sail across the ocean.
The crew devises a plan to whip around a nearby star but things don’t go according to plan.
Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with amnesia.
An old friend of Baird's is running for Mayor of a small New Hampshire town.

Old friend Hurley stumbles into the path of a Mark out for vengeance on the crew.
